name: CENNETIC FA400 Gantry 5-Axis Machining Center
summary: The FA400 is a gantry-type 5-axis machining center for large, heavy multi-axis parts, using a rigid gantry frame to hold accuracy over a big working envelope.
body:
The FA400 is a gantry-type 5-axis machining center for large, heavy multi-axis parts, using a rigid gantry frame to hold accuracy over a big working envelope.

About this model

This 5-Axis Machining Center is manufactured by our partner factory in Dongguan, China, and supplied direct by CENNETIC with factory-direct pricing, a standard warranty and remote setup support. Specifications are representative and can be confirmed against your machining requirements before order.
